name: Lady Mabel Mysteries: Death on Board - Collector’s Edition
summary:
In the tradition of classic murder mysteries, Elephant Games proudly presents Lady Mabel Mysteries: Death on Board, the first entry in a brand-new series!

Mystery author Lady Mabel Porter sets off on a comfort cruise seeking inspiration for her latest detective story, only to find herself tangled up in a real-life mystery of rivalry, passion, and murder! With suspects stacking up and a mysterious figure watching her every move, it’s only a matter of time before Lady Mabel either solves the case or becomes the killer’s next victim! Can you help her solve the case, catch the criminal, and finish her story? There’s just one way to find out! Come aboard and set a course for mayhem in the first exciting entry in a brand new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game series!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
Dive into a secret organization in the bonus chapter!
Stay afloat with the strategy guide!
Earn achievements for your creative gameplay! Complete the collectibles search in the Expedition mode.
Find puzzle pieces, morphing items, and mystery book collectibles! Your reward is a charming bonus puzzle!
Enjoy and save exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, and music!
